changed.detail: Independent bounded JSON/CSV/chat-data ZIP parser for Session/Messages and AgentMessage metadata. Handles UTF8/UTF16 BOM, RFC4180 multiline CSV, chronological ordering when possible, stable-ID dedup, separate threads and nontext exclusion. Never loads executables, reads databases, follows manifest paths, extracts ZIPs or accesses contacts/media.

Explicit self selection, 50/100/200 newest-text range, actual bounded coverage and shortened-message counts, common-identifier masking and exact outbound preview. Per-selection consent and manual BYOK request; structured summary, checked source references, next steps, topics and 1–10 reply suggestions. Data remains user-role input, never elevated instructions.

Wide preparation/result columns, stacked narrow/200% layout, pinned generate/stop/export, collapsed format help, wrapped range/count. Fixed tall-report scroll landing so summary remains above pinned actions. Identity/range/question/count/config changes cancel work, clear consent and invalidate stale reports.

Imports/results remain in process memory, outside normal vault, MessageHub and portable backup. Explicit clear, manual report-only plaintext TXT, copy or polish; no automatic sends, paid development calls, raw-chat logs or user-state schema change.

remaining.detail: Compatibility inferred from provided executable metadata and verified with synthetic matching Session/Messages, AgentMessage and Chinese CSV records only. No supplied executable run, real export generated/imported or paid provider called. Real export samples, group/alias/timestamp edge cases and actual analysis quality remain user acceptance.

remaining.feature: Personal account connector dependencies and actual acceptance
remaining.detail: QQ requires a user-supplied authorized local OneBot11 bridge. WeChat requires user-supplied wxautox4/Python; nickname, bound friend-window and editbox draft guards are intentionally fail-closed and their actual client/library compatibility is unvalidated. No real chats, wxautox4 import or local visible apps were exercised. No QQ protocol implementation bundled.

remaining.feature: Physical Windows installation and third-party-app compatibility
remaining.detail: User chose compilation and isolated regression only. Real Win+Space selection, WeChat/QQ, browsers/Office, UWP, administrator windows, DPI and keyboard shortcut interaction remain unvalidated.
No publisher Authenticode certificate. Do not equate unsigned preview with a signed production release or instruct bypassing system security.
System free bytes: 274788352. All new packages use the authorized data disk. No unrelated files, databases, keys or rollback removed.

Tests used synthetic WAV/PNG and localhost vision/transcription responses. No microphone opened, user chat read or paid API called. Default communication-device capture, model support, recognition accuracy and real app image pasting still need acceptance.

remaining.feature: Persistent import library and whole-history analysis
remaining.detail: Current imports/results are process-memory only; report TXT is explicit plaintext export. No persistent encrypted import library, whole-history chunk summaries, media understanding or cross-device import synchronization.

remaining.feature: Message assistant portable migration and broader channel support
remaining.detail: Independent DPAPI messages.vault is preserved by uninstall but excluded from portable .cqb backup. One connection at a time, private text only; concurrent accounts/platforms, groups, media, history catch-up, reconnect and stable WeChat account identity beyond display name are missing or intentionally not enabled.

CN/EN language-bar item, system-colored monochrome icon, tooltip and left-click/Ctrl+Space switching are implemented and isolated-tested. Actual taskbar appearance, high-contrast rendering and physical interaction remain unvalidated; candidate UIElement/screen-reader integration is still missing. No unsupported immersive, secure-mode or input-mode-compartment capability registered.
Long sentences/new words/mixed languages, low memory, power/latency and extended real-app tests remain. No claim of competitor quality.

Desktop screenshot crop/redaction/vision confirmation, PCM recording/WAV transcription, PNG stickers/custom import, reply history/favorites and credential-free encrypted portable backup are now implemented. Actual microphones, real provider quality, clipboard compatibility and automatic mobile/cloud synchronization remain unvalidated or missing.

remaining.feature: Long-session desktop performance and interactive acceptance
remaining.detail: Offscreen synthetic checks cover the changed core flows and layouts. Long histories, real keyboard navigation, actual combo/model dialogs, high contrast and extended sessions still require user-machine profiling and acceptance.

limits: Only explicit exported files are supported. No extraction or real export compatibility acceptance was performed.
Imports/results are memory-only. Close clears the working session; original export remains untouched. Manual report TXT is plaintext.

Only selected newest text is analyzed, bounded to24000 characters; media and earlier history are excluded and coverage is disclosed. Common identifier replacement is incomplete; user must review outbound preview.
No true WeChat/QQ connector or hardware acceptance, publisher code signing or paid-provider quality claim. Current release remains a preview.
Windows first. Android, iOS archives, backend and payment configuration unchanged.
